purpose: Hard blocklist enforced by the win-modes engine. No mode, preset or imported tweak may stop, disable, remove or block anything listed here.

winget.why: winget ships inside App Installer, which is installed and updated through the Microsoft Store.

chocolatey.why: Chocolatey needs PowerShell, .NET Framework 4.8, TLS 1.2+ and HTTPS downloads; many packages also run MSI installers.
other: Do not disable PowerShell, .NET Framework or TLS 1.2/1.3
Do not block chocolatey.org or community.chocolatey.org

wsl.why: WSL2 and Docker Desktop run in a Hyper-V utility VM.
other: Do not disable VBS/HVCI (it shares the hypervisor)
Do not fully disable IPv6 (breaks mirrored networking)
wsl.modeNote: Modes may run `wsl --shutdown` or edit .wslconfig limits; they must never uninstall WSL or disable its services.

edge-webview2.why: WebView2 powers many Windows and third-party apps (Widgets, Teams, Claude/Codex desktop, installers); Edge is the system handler for several Windows flows.
allowed: Edge policies such as StartupBoostEnabled=0 or BackgroundModeEnabled=0

user-apps.why: Daily tools that must keep working in every mode. A mode may close or not auto-start one of them only if the user explicitly configured it in that mode's profile; the engine never uninstalls them, blocks their network access, firewall rules, updaters, services, protocol handlers (discord://, vscode://, claude://) or their runtimes.

vscode.note: Declared by the user; not found in uninstall keys or PATH on 2026-10-01. Still protected.

spotify.note: Declared by the user; not found on 2026-10-01 (may be a Store or portable install). Still protected.

user-apps.startupIdsNote: Knowledge-base ids of protected startup entries: never suggested for closing by the generator. Docker Desktop is closed only through the mode's wsl.docker setting.
user-apps.rule: Any other AI or developer tool the user adds later inherits this protection.

allowed: Pausing or deferring Windows Update through supported settings

neverInModes.why: Irreversible or reboot-bound changes belong in a one-shot setup page, not in mode switching.
